title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
abstract: arXiv:2611.30161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. translated_title: OpenViVE：越南语视觉蕴含的新基准与双流协同注意力框架
translated_abstract: 视觉蕴含（VE）任务旨在判断一个文本假设相对于图像而言是被蕴含、被矛盾还是无法验证。然而，现有的VE基准主要以英语为中心，未能捕捉越南语特有的语言差异或扎根于文化的视觉语境。为填补这一空白，我们提出了OpenViVE——首个大规模越南语母语VE基准，包含来自10,378张扎根于越南文化的图像的62,268个均衡的图像-假设对。OpenViVE采用一种“伪影感知的LLM-人类混合流水线”构建，该流水线结合了受约束生成、人工验证和PMI引导的精炼。该流水线显著减少了“仅依赖假设”的数据捷径，在伪影精炼后，矛盾类的准确率从96%降至66%。我们进一步评估了一个采用双向协同注意力机制的双流PhoBERT-ConvNeXt框架，以将视觉证据与越南语假设对齐。该框架达到了84.84%的准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个大规模越南语母语视觉蕴含基准OpenViVE（含62,268个图像-假设对），通过伪影感知的LLM-人类混合流水线有效减少数据伪影，并进一步提出基于双向协同注意力的双流PhoBERT-ConvNeXt框架，取得了84.84%的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese visual entailment benchmark with 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs, constructed via an artifact-aware hybrid LLM-human pipeline that substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, and proposes a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention achieving 84.84% accuracy.
